/* isry.subms.stats.eryycose.mapper.EryyCoseMapper - selectExcnBizSemstr[LeeSangHoon] */
SELECT SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO ,SEMSTR_SE_CD FROM AFA310 /* 학기관리 */ WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.subms.stats.eryycose.mapper.EryyCoseMapper - selectAgePreconList[Lee SangHoon] */
WITH AGE_SXDC AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '9' THEN '만 9세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '10' THEN '만 10세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '11' THEN '만 11세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '12' THEN '만 12세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '13' THEN '만 13세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '14' THEN '만 14세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '15' THEN '만 15세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '16' THEN '만 16세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '17' THEN '만 17세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '18' THEN '만 18세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '19' THEN '만 19세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '20' THEN '만 20세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '21' THEN '만 21세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '22' THEN '만 22세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '23' THEN '만 23세' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (T8.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD,T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12,0) = '24' THEN '만 24세' ELSE '기타' END AS AGE /* 집계항목 */ , NVL(T3.SXDC_SE_CD,T2.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC /* 성별구분코드 */
FROM SEB510 T /* 서비스제공대상자 */ LEFT JOIN SEB100 T1 /* 사례기본 */ ON T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 T2 /* 대상자정보 */ ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 T3 /* 개인정보 */ ON T3.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = T2.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SDA100 T4 /* 자원기본 */ ON T4.RESRCE_NO = T.RESRCE_NO AND T4.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SDA420 T5 /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON T5.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T6 /* 서비스사업 */ ON T6.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T5.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SEB500 T8 /* 서비스제공 */ ON T.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T8.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T8.RESRCE_NO = T4.RESRCE_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND T.DEL_YN != 'Y' -- 서비스제공대상자 삭제여부 AND T4.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' -- 승인상태구분코드 AND T4.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' -- 서비스자원대분류구분코드 AND T6.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} -- 사업연도
AND T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} -- 서비스실생사업번호
AND T4.RSFR_INST_NO = #{INST_NO} -- 기관번호
AND T4.OPER_SHAPE_SE_CD = #{OPER_SHAPE_SE_CD} -- 운영형태구분코드
AND T4.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO}
AND T1.CASE_BGNG_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} AND (SELECT UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAA000 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE INST_NO = T4.RSFR_INST_NO) = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} )
SELECT DISTINCT
B.AGE AS TOT_PRVSON /* 집계항목 */ ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AGE_SXDC WHERE AGE = B.AGE AND SXDC= 'M' ) AS MALE_NOPE /* 남자 */ ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AGE_SXDC WHERE AGE = B.AGE AND SXDC= 'F' ) AS FEMALE_NOPE /* 여자 */ ,SRT /* 정렬순서 */
FROM AGE_SXDC A RIGHT JOIN (SELECT CONCAT('만 ',CONCAT((8 + LEVEL),'세')) AS AGE, LEVEL AS SRT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 24 - 9 + 1 UNION SELECT '기타' AS AGE, 99 AS SRT FROM DUAL) B ON A.AGE = B.AGE
ORDER BY B.SRT ASC

/*isry.subms.stats.eryycose.mapper.EryyCoseMapper.selectKlangLevelEvl - 레인보우스쿨 통계 - 한국어평가(레벨테스트) - LEE.SEOUNG.JAE*/ WITH LEVELA_TEST_SCORE AS ( SELECT T2.TRPR_INFO_NO , CASE WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE,0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN '0점~10점이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '10점 초과~20점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '20점 초과~30점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '30점 초과~40점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '40점 초과~50점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 51 AND 60 THEN '50점 초과~60점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 61 AND 70 THEN '60점 초과~70점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN '70점 초과~80점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN '80점 초과~90점 이하' WHEN NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, 0) + NVL(T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE, 0) BETWEEN 91 AND 100 THEN '90점 초과~100점 이하' END AS SCORE
FROM SEB510 T /* 서비스제공대상자 */ LEFT JOIN SEB100 T1 /* 사례기본 */ ON T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 T2 /* 대상자정보 */ ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SDA100 T4 /* 자원기본 */ ON T4.RESRCE_NO = T.RESRCE_NO AND T4.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SDA420 T5 /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON T5.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T6 /* 서비스사업 */ ON T6.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T5.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN AFA320 T8 ON T8.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T8.CASE_MNG_NO = T1.CASE_MNG_NO AND T8.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T8.RESRCE_NO = T4.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN AFA330 T7 ON T7.CASE_MNG_NO = T1.CASE_MNG_NO AND T7.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO
WHERE 1=1 AND T.DEL_YN != 'Y' -- 서비스제공대상자 삭제여부 AND T4.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' -- 승인상태구분코드 AND T4.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' -- 서비스자원대분류구분코드 AND T6.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} -- 사업연도 AND T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' -- 서비스실생사업번호 AND T4.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND T4.OPER_SHAPE_SE_CD LIKE #{OPER_SHAPE_SE_CD} || '%' AND T7.BGNG_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T4.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%'
GROUP BY T2.TRPR_INFO_NO, T8.LEVELA_TEST_REDNG_SCORE, T8.LEVELA_TEST_LSTNA_SCORE )
SELECT NVL(SE,'합계') AS SE , COUNT(B.SCORE) AS SCORE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN '0점~10점이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '10점 초과~20점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '20점 초과~30점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '30점 초과~40점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '40점 초과~50점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 51 AND 60 THEN '50점 초과~60점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 61 AND 70 THEN '60점 초과~70점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN '70점 초과~80점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN '80점 초과~90점 이하' WHEN (LEVEL * 10) BETWEEN 91 AND 100 THEN '90점 초과~100점 이하' END AS SE , LEVEL AS SRT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 10 ) A LEFT JOIN LEVELA_TEST_SCORE B ON B.SCORE = A.SE GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((A.SE, SRT),()) ORDER BY CASE WHEN SE = '합계' THEN 1 END, A.SRT
